blocks.text: This Placement Policy outlines the guidelines and procedures for campus recruitment in autonomous colleges. It aims to ensure a fair and transparent placement process, benefiting both students and recruiters.

items.text: Only final-year students who have completed all academic requirements are eligible to participate.
Students must meet the company’s criteria, including academic performance, skill requirements, and other conditions.
Students with backlogs must clear them before participating subject to the company policy.
Interested students must register with the Placement Cell before the deadline.
A valid and updated resume must be submitted for verification.
Students must attend pre-placement talks (PPT) conducted by recruiters.
A student who receives a job offer cannot apply for further placements unless:
The package of the new opportunity is significantly higher (it should be greater than 1Lakh) The new opportunity is in a core sector relevant to their field.
If a student rejects an offer without valid reasoning, they may be restricted from further placements.
Students must adhere to professional behaviour and ethics during interviews.
Misconduct, misrepresentation, or indiscipline will result in disqualification from placements.
Students must respect the confidentiality of placement-related information.
The Placement Cell may prioritize certain companies based on reputation, compensation, or industry relevance.
If a company withdraws an offer due to unforeseen circumstances, the student may be allowed to reapply.
The Placement Cell reserves the right to make final decisions on disputes or exceptions.
Any grievances must be submitted in writing to the Placement Office.

blocks.text: This policy ensures a smooth and efficient placement process, providing equal opportunities to all students.
